reason: 该插件面向用户提供文本处理与统计能力，在会话中可调用 `text_transform` 完成多种命名格式转换，以及 `text_stats` 计算字符、词、行和字节等指标，属于文本数据处理向的实用工具插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件提供字符串处理工具，可在会话中进行大小写、驼峰、蛇形、短横线及 slug 转换，并可统计字符、词、行和字节等文本信息。
summaries.en: This plugin provides string tools for conversational use, including text case and naming conversions (camel, snake, kebab, slug) and text statistics such as character, word, line, and byte counts.

capabilities: text transformation between case and naming styles including camel, snake, kebab, and slug
text statistics for characters, words, lines, and bytes

reasons.code: 仓库简介直接说明插件为“字符串工具”，核心功能为大小写与多种命名风格转换以及文本统计。
README 的“提供的工具”表格列出 `text_transform`，作用为大小写/驼峰/蛇形/短横线/slug 转换。
README 的“提供的工具”表格列出 `text_stats`，作用为字符/词/行/字节统计。

capabilities: text transformation between case and naming styles including camel, snake, kebab, and slug
text statistics for characters, words, lines, and bytes
